facts.source: The Guardian, https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/20/abdul-el-sayed-heckler; published 2026-10-20T12:45:48Z, modified 17:57:40Z; by Jason Wilson
facts.fact: Guardian reports that the man it identifies via The Handbasket as Thomas “Tommy” Teepell heckled El-Sayed about the Muslim Brotherhood, and reports the exchange drew over 50m views across platforms. It says FEC filing records Breakthrough LLC received $250,000 from America Next on Sep 29 for canvassing/influencer marketing opposing El-Sayed. It also reports a University of Michigan College Republicans member saying he acted for America Next offered $200 to boo/question El-Sayed at a Flint town hall on Oct 1.
facts.limit: These are Guardian’s reported claims. Article explicitly says nothing in filings shows Thomas Teepell was paid by Breakthrough or America Next; no independent FEC documents or incident video captured here, and no inference of quantifiable vote effect.
